source_page: CISI Pakistan IA leaf n372 / printed p.338, HARAPPA 899-911 TABLETS incised no iconography
question: Does source-visible H-910 B (+700-034+) clarify component assignment after H-938 B (+034-700+) weakened direct 034/415 support?
local_order_assumption: R/L means first local token maps to rightmost visible component
component_implication_under_RL: H-910 +700-034+ maps 700 to the right vertical/rake component and 034 to the left loop/leaf component; this is consistent with H-938 B mapping 034 to the right loop/leaf and 700 to the left vertical/rake.
answer: H-910 B strengthens the negative component result: in two source-visible companion sides, 034 tracks the loop/leaf component, while 700 tracks the vertical/rake component under the local R/L assumption. It does not support 034=415.
